verdict.rationale: Modal explicitly documents a 'Sandbox Snapshots' feature (modal-docs-9), confirming snapshot capability exists, but the evidence pack gives no detail on the actual snapshot/restore/fork API mechanics, no confirmation that new independent sandboxes can be forked from a single snapshot, and no community/hands-on corroboration of this specific workflow. missing for 10: documented API details on restoring/forking multiple sandboxes from one snapshot, independent/hands-on confirmation of snapshot-restore-fork workflow, and clarity on any beta/experimental limitations.
